headline: Jogorku Kenesh committee approves agreement with EBRD on a loan of 1 billion euros
summary: A committee of the Kyrgyz Jogorku Kenesh approved an agreement with the EBRD allowing Kyrgyzstan to borrow up to 1 billion euros for municipal and sustainable infrastructure.
why: The EBRD is the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, a multilateral lender whose loans fund public infrastructure projects in its countries of operation.
original_headline: Комитет ЖК одобрил соглашение с ЕБРР на кредит в 1 миллиард евро
